'''Blainekie''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]], who worked as a researcher for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. He investigated [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] in [[Wampa Valley]] during the lead-up to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
